name: command-center
description: A development cockpit for any project: live status band, next-step suggestions, a pane for this session, all sessions, PRs, files and change impact, a guard for risky commands, turn receipts and a desktop skin.

budget_usd.title: Session budget (USD)
budget_usd.description: Cost meter and warnings at 50%, 80% and 100% of this. 0 turns the budget off.

context_alert_pct.title: Context warning (%)
context_alert_pct.description: Warn once when the context window passes this.

sound.title: Chime when a session needs you
sound.description: Soft chime on a permission prompt or a question.

guard.title: Guard risky commands
guard.description: Hold force-pushes, hard resets, rm -rf, PR merges and the like until you confirm.

next_steps.title: Suggest next steps
next_steps.description: After a turn, up to three likely next prompts above the prompt box (costs about one short reply).

receipt.title: Turn receipt
receipt.description: One dim line under an answer: time, tools, lines changed, cost.

skin.title: Desktop tool icons
skin.description: Outlined icons beside tool rows in the desktop app.

band.title: Status band
band.description: The one-line status above the prompt.

prs.title: Track pull requests
prs.description: Your PRs across every gh account, refreshed every 5 minutes.

impact.title: Impact of edits
impact.description: Which files depend on each file Claude edits.

impact_warn.title: Shared-file warning
impact_warn.description: Warn when an edited file has at least this many dependents.

auto_open.title: Open the pane at start
auto_open.description: Open the Command Center pane when a session starts.
